name: elmcap2
headline: Rests maker bids at 0.95-0.97 on long-dated political and event markets and holds to resolution. Profitable and significant, but it ties up about $6.5M to earn about $242k a month (3.7% per month), below the 10% per month bar.
mechanism: 98% of sampled fills are maker fills (on-chain, 95% CI 95-99%). Median fill price 0.95; 77% of resolved markets won. Income is carry on near-certain outcomes plus Polymarket holding yield ($12.4k in 30 days). Losses come from the minority of positions bought at 0.5-0.85 that resolved against it.

roc.detail: peak capital at risk $6.46M (p95 $5.35M); 30-day PnL $242k; 3.7% per month < 10%

onchain.detail: 200/200 sampled fills confirmed on Polygon; maker share 98%

match.detail: not run: rejected at stage A2

backtest.detail: not run: rejected at stage A2

reasons: Return on capital 3.7% per month on $6.46M peak capital at risk; the pre-registered bar is 10% per month.
Profit depends on holding yield (a Polymarket incentive program) for about 5% of PnL.
